ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a macro-level ratio of approximately 9:1 relative to high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-contrast white mottling localized at the distal tip of the left lobe; vertical white linear streaks at the mid-section of both lobes; overall pigmentation is solid black across the central fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 45 degrees, though the base vertex is partially occluded by water displacement.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels; trailing edge exhibits a jagged, saw-tooth profile more pronounced on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic sweep extending symmetrically from the central axis toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast white circular spots consistent with barnacle scarring on the leftmost distal margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct unaligned linear pixel disruptions: one prominent vertical white scratch on the left lobe and two finer parallel vertical scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical rake-mark scars; irregular and potentially traumatic serration patterns on the trailing edge indicative of historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentrated white pigmentation at the extreme left fluke tip contrasting with the dark intensity of the surrounding pixels.
